depth_only_ridge.input: log1p(library_size_umi), from the per-spot total UMI field
depth_only_ridge.participant_weighting: 1 / finite training rows per participant, normalized to mean 1
depth_only_ridge.scaling: weighted mean and population standard deviation; scales below 1e-12 or non-finite replaced by 1

color_only_ridge.input: Stage 1 color_statistics(rgb) features on each RGB spot tile
color_only_ridge.pixel_input: PIL RGB conversion to uint8; raw RGB values and cv2.COLOR_RGB2HSV output; statistics over axes (0, 1)
color_only_ridge.statistics: per-channel mean and population standard deviation; no additional normalization
color_only_ridge.participant_weighting: 1 / finite training rows per participant, normalized to mean 1
color_only_ridge.scaling: weighted mean and population standard deviation; scales below 1e-12 or non-finite replaced by 1

target_scaling: same weighted scaling as frozen MLP; verified within 1e-12
randomness: Ridge fitting and preprocessing are deterministic; no RNG seed is used
